cards.mood: The piece opens with a somber, atmospheric stillness that gradually accumulates tension through the verses.
cards.palette: Heavily distorted electric guitars serve as the core harmonic driver, present throughout the track but shifting from clean, arpeggiated patterns in the intro and verses to thick, palm-muted power chords in the choruses.

[Intro]
[Verse]
Walking through the gray and hollow fields
Tracing lines across the frozen ground
Every shadow holds a secret weight
Silence is the only steady sound

Waiting for the storm to begin

Tear the veils of every doubt
Rising from the heavy haze
Lost inside the tangled maze

Leaving all the old ghosts behind

Rising from the heavy haze
